reviews.text: Unable to send via email. Love the art! My only qualm is that I’m unable to email to a friend. The feature says email is not set up, but there’s no options to set it up.
Powerful messages with beautiful images. I love this deck and how it is written. It’s been transformational for me. I wholeheartedly recommend the Sacred Rebels app/deck!
Ad pops up every time I open the app…. I love this deck and it’s a great app, but considering it’s not free it’s super disappointing to have to open to an ad every time I use it.
reviews.theme: реклама и попапы в платном приложении

reviews.text: Best! Deep and wise. I use this deck everyday and have for years. It connects me to my Self and the Divine every time. I LOVE IT!

Alignment wonky, otherwise wonderful cards. The art, messages, and exercises with the Sacred Rebel Oracle cards are all insightful and helpful. However, lately the text is not centered and about 30% of the content is lost. Hope that gets fixed soon.

Great cards, text hard to read. I absolutely love this deck, both as cards and the app. The artwork and messages are stunning and empowering. But the text for the card meanings is hard to read in the app confined to a small box that requires endless scrolling. It feels claustrophobic. Other deck apps just include the text on the same screen, not confined to such a small space, and the user experience is far more pleasant. Fix this and it’s easily a five-star app.

First time using cards!. So I had never used any kind of Taro cards, or anything before last week. My friend owns the physical book and deck, but after trying it just once wirh her, I bought this app and it was such a good choice! It was the push I needed and opened me up to new ideas and belief systems. I'd recommend to anyway, especially first timers! (Sorry did any incorrect phrases or spellings, this is literally my entry point into this side of beliefs)

Font too small, content is great. Great archetypal content with fairly solid philosophical and spiritual foundations. I was surprised. Biggest problem is that there is a lot of content for each card (love content I’m a writer) and the font is MUCH TOO SMALL to easily or comfortably read that much content. 

Please make the font larger would def give this 5 stars then. Thx!
Beautiful and inspirational cards. These cards are very lovely and are inspirational. I also like the Mother Mary cards as well.
Amazing!!. This oracle deck is beautifully designed and written!! Each card packs a lot of information to focus you!! It's spot on!! I love it!!
Great app!. Looking forward to more great things coming.
Love,love,love this deck’. I like it so much I ordered the cards for readings! Thank you :)

Incredible!!!. Alana’s are The greatest app’s available! 
Rumi. Kuan Yin and the Rebel are my everyday spiritual family!!
Thank you thank you!!!

Accurate and inspiring. These are the best oracle cards have bought in years. They are spot on with how I feel and what I need to hear. The process at the end of each message make these cards one of a kind. Would love to see the processes in audio form. I would pay the money. More please!
So Beautiful. Love this ap. The descriptions are really nice and the art is lovely.
Love!. The images are clear and the readings are so accurate.
Wow!. Love this deck!!!
SUPERB ❤️. Beautiful, thought provoking insight!

Uplifting & Gorgeous. Please stop showing pop-up ads on an app I just paid $7 for. Thanks

EDIT: Updating my review because the developers responded with how to turn off these alerts. (Settings > Sacred Rebels > turn off News Alerts)

Now - No complaints! Love the app. Art is beautiful. Words are inspiring. Thank you! ❤️

reviews.text: Yup. Amazing. Love this deck, enriching. So uplifting and thoughtful:)

Problems. The writing on most of the cards is not properly in the box. So the writing is on the pattern part of the screen making it almost impossible to read. Also, I tried to email a reading and it will Not send.

I’ve paid £7.99 for this. Can I have a refund?

Gorgeous Deck. This is such a beautiful deck I’m going to purchase a physical deck. I stumbled upon Alana Fairchild in an interview in the Biddy Tarot podcast and heard them speak of this deck, among other things and I knew I had to check out her website. I realised there was an app for the sacred rebels deck and I’m in love with it, I must have one if these decks in my hands ❤️

Empowering. I love all of Alana Fairchild’s oracle cards and apps but this one is probably my favourite - along with the mandalas one, but the one I come back to most. Less specific than the Isis oracle (also great) or the Nother Mary one. Really empowering, spiritual without being cheesy,and always spot on, for me anyway. The readings are pretty long, and there’s a healing process at the end. It’s especially good if you’re creative (which we all are, in our own way) but great for anyone who wants a bit of insight and guidance, and a boost ❤️ The physical deck is great too but I love the ease of using the apps.
Beautiful. Incredible wisdom and guidance.

The best!. I have a big collection of Oracle cards and Tarots. I bought this app and l was so impressed with the accuracy of the cards that l bought the deck of cards too. It is 100% accurate. I highly recommend this app.
Sacred rebels. Beautiful deck incredible inspiration and insight
Awesome app!. My only complaint is that there are too many promotional pop-ups. I wish there was an option to turn off the advertisements.
